payload.claim: `SPEC_ID_DIRS` hardcodes the retired-specs directory name as the literal `"done"` inside `".saffron/specs/done"`, instead of using the `RETIRED_DIRNAME` constant `saffron/scheduler.py` already defines for exactly this name (`RETIRED_DIRNAME = "done"`, scheduler.py:628) and that `saffron/draft.py` and `saffron/follow_up.py` already import rather than restate. No gate catches a restated constant whose value happens to agree with the original; per the repo's own rule this is a finding even though both values are `"done"` today. A future rename of the retired directory would silently desync this gate's view of which ids are known from `_retired_ids`'s.
